headline: CoreWeave Boosts AI Compute Demand & Related Stocks
detail: CoreWeave's strong report and CEO's comments reaffirm robust AI compute demand. This is positive for the broader AI sector, specifically mentioning Micron, which could indirectly support your leveraged MUU position.
rec: While positive for the sector, your MUU is deeply underwater (-48.63%) and a "SELL." This news isn't strong enough to justify adding to a losing leveraged position.

headline: Market Angst Shifts from AI to Low-Volatility Stocks
detail: Despite some positive AI news, the broader market is showing "angst" and a rotation out of the "AI trade" into lower-volatility names. This directly impacts your highly concentrated, high-beta tech/chip portfolio.
rec: Given your heavy concentration and margin, consider trimming profitable tech positions like CRWD (+34.81%) or SPY (+3.3%) to reduce overall risk and exposure to a potentially stumbling AI sector.
